profile.headline: Software Engineer: Enterprise AI Applications
profile.summary:
I’m a versatile and reliable Software Engineer with over 5 years of experience turning complex challenges into practical, user-focused solutions. I thrive on collaboration and creativity, using my skills in Python, Java, and other modern tools to build impactful, scalable systems.

At Apple, I played a crucial role in modernizing legacy systems by transitioning them to microservices, greatly improving their flexibility and scalability. At Walmart, I independently designed and deployed an automated branch hygiene tool that supported multiple repositories and improved repository resource usage substantially. I also developed a high-impact service for detecting configuration drifts between production environments, enhancing deployment safety and compliance.

In my personal life, I built an AI stock recommender that pulls stock data from Yahoo Finance and sorts and filters stocks based on performance and other metrics. It then passes that list to Google Gemini to get market outlook, stock sentiment, and other qualitative analyses, and then serves up the final recommendations on a website daily.

I’m excited to join innovative teams pushing the boundaries of technology. Let’s connect to explore how my skills can help drive your mission forward!

positions.title: Software Engineer: Enterprise AI Applications
positions.locationName: Mountain View, California, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Software Engineer 3
positions.description:
Config Comparator Service
  -  Developed a high-impact service to detect and alert on configuration drifts between production
environments (proda vs. prodb), leveraging a custom recursive JSON flattener for accuracy.
  -  Enabled rule-based filters and cron scheduling for targeted monitoring, improving deployment safety and configuration compliance for 2 services with the ability to onboard new services.

Stale Branch Pruner Service:
  -  Independently designed, developed, and implemented a fully automated and configurable service that monitors, notifies, and manages stale branches across multiple GitHub repositories using Github's GraphQL API, Python, and Walmart's Concord Yaml.
  -  The service detects stale branches, stores them in a JSON store database, notifies branch owners, and deletes them after a set number of days if no action is taken, which improved codebase hygiene and reduces clutter.
  -  Successfully deployed the service across 7 GitHub repositories and 3 teams detecting thousands of stale branches, with ongoing expansion to more repositories and teams.

On-Call for Walmart.com:
  -  Managed the end-to-end flow of over 1 billion item data documents from Walmart’s central database to customer-facing datacenters across the U.S., Canada, and Mexico.
  -  Oversaw item data flows for Walmart’s B2B platform and advertising services, ensuring consistent and accurate data delivery.
  -  Daily responsibilities include troubleshooting pipeline issues, monitoring job progression, replacing failed cloud nodes, installing necessary data and software, and coordinating with cross-functional teams.

positions.title: Theatre Team Member
positions.locationName: San Jose, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Worked the box office to sell tickets and performed refunds, dealt with rude customers, and directed movie goers to their theater. 
This was the first summer after COVID. During my Masters program, I was offered a remote software engineering internship but chose this job instead because I was sick of being indoors and wanted to get out and socialize.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Modernized a legacy monolith into microservices, including a checkout service that computed transaction totals
(pricing, promotions, taxes), improving system availability, deployment agility through isolated service updates.
• Designed and implemented the checkout service’s APIs and backend using Java 8/11, J2EE (Servlets, JDBC), and
Oracle SQL, integrating it with other microservices to enable reliable multi-region POS transactions.
• Ensured financial accuracy and functional parity by reusing and maintaining the monolith’s JUnit tests, leveraging
• Debugged issues as raised by QA

positions.title: Crew Member
positions.description:
Operated point-of-sale terminals to complete guest transactions at the box office and concession stands, prepared foods, performed custodial duties in the auditoriums and lobby, enforced alcohol compliance, and recommended movies to guests
Sold over 200 loyalty memberships to guests over a three month period

positions.title: Merchandiser
positions.description: Cashiered and documented amounts in cash register daily, merchandised the store and worked the warehouse, did inventory on ALL the store’s items (took awhile), shipped items to other Fry’s locations, gave tech advice to customers

positions.title: Service Specialist (Grocery Bagger)
positions.description: Bagged groceries, brought back shopping carts from the parking lot, dealt with rude customers, swept the floors, put items back on shelves, assisted the disabled and elderly with groceries to their cars.
